threats.title: Unauthenticated ADS-B self-report spoofing
threats.mechanism: Fabricated or altered ADS-B content creates false targets or wrong reported positions; the cross-check may flag but ATM still consumes the feed.

threats.title: GNSS spoofing of position and timing
threats.mechanism: False GNSS signals bias reported position and clock discipline; a covert offset propagates into all TOA/FOA stamps.

threats.title: Covert onboard clock step bias
threats.mechanism: A step within the weak-pass stealth window biases every observable; monitor and cross-check do not flag it per W1/W3.

threats.title: PTP time-transfer message tampering
threats.mechanism: Delay or alter PTP messages to offset satellite clocks; the bias becomes range error and position shift.

threats.title: Telecommand or update compromise
threats.mechanism: Unauthorised command, firmware or configuration changes payload behaviour, clock handling or reporting path.

threats.title: Key management credential compromise
threats.mechanism: Exposure of command, ISL or ground-link keys enables later impersonation, injection or command attacks.

threats.title: Integrity threshold and filter poisoning
threats.mechanism: Altered thresholds, filter parameters or cross-check rules suppress flags and admit biased tracks.

threats.title: Synchronisation policy manipulation
threats.mechanism: Changing time scale or PTP conformance policy causes systematic timing bias or missed detection across satellites.

threats.title: Ephemeris and orbit product poisoning
threats.mechanism: Wrong satellite positions or clock states bias localisation and mask geometric inconsistencies.

threats.title: Solver tracker database manipulation
threats.mechanism: Corrupt association, filter state or track database to shift, merge or drop aircraft tracks.

threats.title: Integrity monitor tampering
threats.mechanism: Disable or bias residual tests so non-conforming solutions receive nominal integrity.

threats.title: Cross-check verdict manipulation
threats.mechanism: Alter comparison logic or indicator to mask ADS-B discrepancy or falsely discredit a genuine aircraft.

threats.title: Central processing platform compromise
threats.mechanism: Host compromise permits modification of all processing modules, stored tracks and integrity decisions.

threats.title: Payload processor firmware compromise
threats.mechanism: Altered extraction firmware biases TOA, FOA, AOA or clock stamping and corrupts all reports.

threats.title: Satellite bus flight software compromise
threats.mechanism: Platform control allows payload disablement, data alteration or command-path abuse.

threats.title: ASTERIX encoder gateway injection
threats.mechanism: Injected or modified ASTERIX reports carry wrong positions or integrity annotations to ATM.

threats.title: ATM surveillance feed manipulation
threats.mechanism: Alter or inject target reports and integrity annotations on the surveillance feed before ATM consumption.

threats.title: ATM system and display compromise
threats.mechanism: Compromised ATM presents a false or degraded picture; controller decisions realise the consequence.

threats.title: Insider or supplier privileged misuse
threats.mechanism: Authorised access to L3/L4 assets is abused for configuration, key or data manipulation with weak attribution.

threats.title: Mission operations network compromise
threats.mechanism: Breach of mission operations network exposes governance assets and permits tampering with logs and controls.

threats.title: Observable report tampering in transit
threats.mechanism: Modify report measurements or metadata across ISL or downlink; the solver receives biased observations.

threats.title: Downlink and backhaul interception
threats.mechanism: Passive exposure of reports, ephemerides or traffic supports later targeting and deception.

threats.title: ISL relay jamming or injection
threats.mechanism: Degrade crosslinks or inject relayed reports, reducing coverage or biasing association.

threats.title: Ground station modem compromise
threats.mechanism: Compromised ground modem or antenna path modifies downlink and telecommand traffic.

threats.title: RF front-end jamming or saturation
threats.mechanism: Jamming or saturation degrades reception and AOA, reducing coverage below the requirement.

threats.title: Measurement association poisoning
threats.mechanism: Mismatch or inject receptions to group unrelated transmissions and corrupt track initiation.

architecture_weaknesses: W1 assumes literature-proven covert clock steps escape L1 checks; this is not validated for the LEO payload and may overstate stealth.
W2/W3 treat strong and weak passes as cleanly separable; HDOP and threshold uncertainty may create undetected windows in strong passes.
The ADS-B self-report is unauthenticated, so cross-check cannot distinguish aircraft deception from ground or timing faults.
GNSS and PTP are both external timing inputs; no independent holdover or fault detection is specified for A1.5.
TB2/TB3 rely on shared backhaul and management networks; broad insider and supplier access weakens attribution and separation.
Ephemeris production and solver trust are coupled; no independent authentication or consistency check for A4.2/A3.2 is stated.
ATM receives integrity annotations over one feed; no end-to-end attestation to the controller working position is described.
Monitor claims cover single-satellite bias; correlated multi-satellite, ephemeris and timing biases are not explicitly bounded.
overall: The architecture has strong cross-layer timing and integrity dependencies, but unauthenticated ADS-B, external GNSS/PTP and broad ground trust make displacement and deception plausible. Highest priorities are authenticated timing and reports, ephemeris/config/key integrity, monitor independence and end-to-end ATM attestation.
